input.overview: Mars Trek is a Bonus-control game. Build the base value through the top saucer, E and K return lanes, upper-left star rollover, and right spinner; complete E and K to double the end-of-ball payout. The right collect saucer pays the current base Bonus immediately but does not include the doubler, so a maxed, doubled Bonus is usually worth preserving for the drain. Avoid the dangerous MARS targets unless an award is close.
input.simpleOverview: In Mars Trek, build Bonus through the top saucer, E and K return lanes, upper-left star rollover, and right spinner. Complete E and K to double the end-of-ball payout. Avoid the center and upper-right MARS targets. When Bonus is high and doubled, do not collect it at the right saucer—the saucer pays only the base value.
input.summary: Shoot the safer Bonus advances, complete E and K for Double Bonus, and preserve a large doubled value for end of ball. Use the right collect saucer only when taking the base Bonus now is better than risking the rest of the ball.

quickInfo.name: E and K lanes
quickInfo.summary: Complete both to double end-of-ball Bonus.

quickInfo.name: Bonus advances
quickInfo.summary: Top saucer, E and K returns, upper-left star, and right spinner.

quickInfo.name: Right collect saucer
quickInfo.summary: Collect the current base Bonus, then add one Bonus advance.

quickInfo.name: 50,000 Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Light Extra Ball at the runway when that award is enabled.

quickInfo.name: MARS TREK
quickInfo.summary: Complete the targets to light Special; this is the riskier route.

steps.text: Plunge for the top saucer or a useful E or K lane, using a light nudge to improve the upper feed.
From the flippers, favor the right spinner and safe feeds into the E and K return lanes to build Bonus.
Complete whichever of E or K is missing so the end-of-ball Bonus becomes doubled.
When base Bonus is high and doubled, keep it for end of ball instead of shooting the right collect saucer.
Shoot the MARS targets only when a short completion can reach an enabled Extra Ball or Special without abandoning the safer Bonus route.
Advance the base Bonus through saucers, lanes, the star rollover, and spinner.
Complete E and K to light Double Bonus.
Preserve the doubled value for the end-of-ball count.

machineSetup: Confirm three- or five-ball play and whether Extra Ball and Special are enabled, converted to points, or disabled. Tournament settings often remove the award value without changing the Bonus route.

Test the top saucer, right collect saucer, E and K lanes, upper-left star rollover, spinner, Bonus to 100,000, Double Bonus lamp, 50,000 Extra Ball qualification, runway award, MARS and TREK target scoring, and all saucer kickouts.

playfieldReferences.label: Top Bonus saucer
playfieldReferences.description: Upper kickout that advances Bonus and spots a TREK letter.

playfieldReferences.label: Right spinner
playfieldReferences.description: Bonus-advance spinner on the route toward the collect saucer.

playfieldReferences.label: Collect Bonus saucer
playfieldReferences.description: Right-side kickout that pays the undoubled base Bonus.

playfieldReferences.label: MARS target group
playfieldReferences.description: Upper-right target sequence used with TREK to qualify Special.
